The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
releases.summary:
Every Who down in Who-ville is jingling, singing and celebrating. And guess who can’t wait to join them… the Grinch! Now, with a heart three sizes bigger, and a wish to show the Whos he’s changed, could the Grinch’s prize-winning tree be the perfect way to prove it?

Play as the Grinch and Jumbo-Jump through snowy 3D worlds, collecting ornaments to make your tree sparkle brighter with every step. Overcome platforming challenges, explore every nook and cranny, and use the clever gadgets you find to get through each level. Unleash the Snowball Maker to freeze mischievous adversaries, launch into action with the Rocket Skates, and reach new heights with the Jetpack.

Each level is filled with festive adventures. Hop through the Grinch’s Cave, dodging falling stalactites and zipping down watery chutes. Conquer Mt. Crumpit’s slippery ice and giant rolling snowballs. Find your way through Who-wood’s towering trees and springy mushrooms. Then explore Who-ville, leaping across hovering platforms and sneaking into the Whos’ cozy homes. Use your candy canes to break objects and release dazzling ornaments to decorate the Grinch’s Christmas tree and Who-ville Square.

Adventure solo or team up in local co-op mode. Together with Max, you’ll have fun outsmarting pesky mice, wild forest bats and other curious creatures. Uncover hidden paths and collect every sparkly decoration you can find to make your tree shine.

Make it a merry day in Who-ville, spread Christmas cheer, and create the most spectacular tree the Whos have ever seen!

releases.name: Another Eden Begins
releases.summary:
Aldo and his younger sister, Feinne, enjoy a peaceful life in the idyllic village of Baruoki, until one day, when Feinne is taken by the Beast King. 

Aldo pursues them into the Moonlight Forest, but following a fierce battle with a beast, he is sent through a tear in spacetime - and finds himself in a world 800 years in the future.

Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

Experience the story of the origin and beginning of the long-running Tristia series with graphics that have been completely revised for modern times while retaining the fun of inventing in the workshop.

releases.name: Classroom Mystery Secrets Behind the Lessons
releases.summary:
Can you spot the unease hiding in class?

At first glance, it looks like an ordinary day at school.
But look closer, and a small sense of unease may point to a chilling truth.

Use the question as your guide, study the illustration carefully, and find the suspicious spot that leads to the truth in this visual deduction quiz.

How to play is simple!
・Read the question
・Take a close look at the school illustration
・Choose the place you think is suspicious

Classrooms, hallways, club activities, and after-school scenes set the stage for strange moments hiding inside familiar school life.

A scene that seemed normal at first might feel completely different once you realize what it really means.

No complicated steps—just observation and a flash of insight. Take your time solo, or play with family and friends while asking, Which part looks off?

Recommended if you like:
・Stories that turn creepy once you understand them
・Horror and mystery
・Illustration observation quizzes
・Testing your deduction and attention to detail
・Quick quiz games you can enjoy in short breaks

releases.name: Math Pals - Monster Mania
releases.summary:
Learn math with friendly monsters and fun challenges.

This game is an educational math game designed for preschool and elementary school children.

Children learn core math skills—counting, addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division—through playful, monster-themed multiple-choice quizzes. Each topic is divided into 20 levels that gradually increase in difficulty, starting with small numbers and visual aids and building up to larger numbers and more advanced tasks.

Every level features a highscore and star rating, giving children,
parents, and teachers a clear overview of progress and confidence in each topic.

Tasks vary constantly: counting monsters, adding dice and fingers, finding missing numbers, combining animals or creatures, and more. Built-in spaced repetition ensures that learned topics return naturally over time, helping children retain knowledge without pressure.
Friendly monsters celebrate success, encourage effort, and make learning math feel fun and rewarding—while mistakes are treated gently as part of the learning journey.

releases.name: Psychopath Mind Quiz: Unmask Their Dark Nature
releases.summary:
Can you pick the “normal” answer? Dark mind teasers await Unmask the hidden choice!

Does your answer seem as ordinary as you think?

Take on a slightly dark psychological quiz built around chilling situations. Study each image, choose from the options, and try to spot the line of thought that feels just a little different from the usual response.

Playing is easy!
・Study the image
・Think about what you would do
・Choose one answer from four options

“Why would someone act like that?”
“What were they thinking in that moment?”
The reveal behind each answer may give you a little shiver.

No complicated steps needed. It is quick to play in short sessions, great for thinking things through on your own or guessing with friends by asking, “Which one would you pick?”

Recommended for anyone who likes:
・Psychology quizzes and mind teasers
・Unexpected answers and tricky questions
・Testing deduction and intuition
・Quick quizzes for spare moments
・A slightly dark theme
